title: Bram and the Letter
author: Juniper Voss
blurb: Ines Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
